aeupgrade.tree.atlas.core_hint: Follow any of the six sectors from the ME Core. The rings link neighboring sectors at three distances.
aeupgrade.tree.atlas.pair: Research the central relay and either branch terminal.
aeupgrade.tree.atlas.exclusive: Researching this node closes the other branch in this sector.
aeupgrade.tree.atlas.two_gate_hint: Research any two input terminals. The two remaining terminals will close.
aeupgrade.tree.atlas.three_gate_hint: Research any three input terminals. The fourth terminal will close.
aeupgrade.tree.atlas.crossing: This junction has alternate approaches from the connected paths.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.search: Filters the map by node name or by ID written as #7.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.parameter_sea: Finds matching fields and effects in the selected node or route. Matching groups expand automatically.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.grid: Snaps dragged nodes to the grid. Hold Shift while dragging to move freely.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.shortcuts.map:
Mouse wheel — zoom
Right-click — menu · right-drag — pan
Drag empty space — box-select
Shift/Ctrl + click — toggle selection
Shift/Ctrl + box — add to selection
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.shortcuts.obj:
Click a node to select, drag to move
Arrow keys — nudge selected nodes
Shift + drag — bypass snapping
Click a link to select, again to add a point
Drag a waypoint — change its route
Esc — deselect the link
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.shortcuts.cli:
Ctrl+C — copy nodes
Ctrl+V — paste nodes at cursor
Ctrl+Shift+C — copy effects
Ctrl+Shift+V — paste effects
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.shortcuts.edi:
Ctrl+Z — undo
Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z — redo
Delete — remove nodes or a waypoint
Enter — apply coordinates
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.starfield: Draws stars around researched nodes. Turning this off reduces GPU load.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.animated_link: Animates the connections between researched nodes. Turning this off keeps those lines static.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.available_nod: Highlights upgrades you can research now with spreading rings and blinking incoming links.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.show_requirem: Lists required nodes in player tooltips. The research rules apply in either state.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.starting_poin: Free points available to a new ME network. They count toward the maximum.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.budget: Caps the total points in a network, including points already spent on upgrades.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.refund_percen: Sets the percentage returned on a reset and, if enabled, on controller destruction. Fractional points round down.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.drop_research: Drops certificates when the final controller block breaks. The refund percentage applies to earned points, including spent ones.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.operator_only: Restricts research management to operators. When off, the controller owner can also research and redeem certificates.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.name: Name shown to players. Enter plain text or a translation key prefixed with @.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.description: Extra text in the node tooltip. Supports plain text and translation keys prefixed with @.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.cost: How many research points the network spends to unlock this node.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.position: Coordinates in the tree, in map units. X increases to the right and Y increases downward.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.x: Horizontal position. Larger values move the node to the right.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.y: Vertical position. Larger values move the node downward.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.prerequisite_: IDs of incoming nodes, separated by commas or spaces. Use -1 alone for the ME Core or leave blank to keep the node disconnected.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.pick: Select a node on the map to add it as an incoming connection.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.prerequisite_: How many connected nodes must be researched first. Enter 3 to require any three of four inputs. Auto requires one when nodes are connected.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.lock_remainin: Locks the unused incoming branches when the required number has been researched.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.fork: IDs of nodes whose branches close when this upgrade is researched. Separate them with commas or spaces.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.hide_descenda: Keeps this node visible and hides its outgoing paths until it is researched. Children with enough other visible inputs can still appear.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.hide_until_pr: Hides this node until enough prerequisites are researched. Its outgoing paths stay hidden in the meantime.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.diameter: Size of the node frame on the map, from 8 to 128. Larger values make the node stand out.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.shape: Shape of the node frame. It also defines the outline that clips its background layers.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.border_color: Outline color and endpoint color for connected lines. Enter #RRGGBB or leave blank to use the default.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.border_width: Thickness of the outline at rest. Leave blank for the default or enter 0 to hide it.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.border_hover_: Outline thickness when the pointer is over the node. Leave blank for the default hover thickness.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.icon: Preview shown in the node center. Enter an item ID or a PNG path, or choose one from the picker.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.backgrounds: PNG layers drawn behind the icon in list order. Later layers appear above earlier ones.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_shape: Chooses how the line travels between nodes and waypoints. It changes the path drawn on the map.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_reset: Removes all waypoints and restores the default straight line between the nodes.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_add_poin: Adds a waypoint that the connection line will pass through.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_point: Selects and highlights this waypoint on the map.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_point_up: Moves the waypoint earlier in the order the line follows.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_point_do: Moves the waypoint later in the order the line follows.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_remove_p: Removes this waypoint and draws the line through the remaining points.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_point_x: Horizontal map coordinate of the waypoint. Increasing it moves the point right.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.link_point_y: Vertical map coordinate of the waypoint. Increasing it moves the point down.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.add_effect: Adds a bonus or penalty that becomes active when this upgrade is researched.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.remove_effect: Removes this effect from the node's draft.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect_type: Selects the property changed by the upgrade. The add-on that registered this effect defines how its value applies.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect_target: Applies the effect to the selected family in this ME network. All devices includes every supported family.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect_unit: AE/t adds a fixed amount. Percent changes consumption relative to its base value.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect_percen: The applied percentage appears next to the effect. An input of 1.5 applies 15%.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect_toolti: Sets the effect text color in the node tooltip. Leave blank to color bonuses and penalties automatically.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.channe: Adds or removes cable channels in this ME network. Dense cables scale with normal cables.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.patter: Adds or removes pattern slots on each Pattern Provider in the network.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.interf: Changes how many pairs of configuration and stock slots each ME Interface has.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.batch: Changes the number of crafts of one recipe an assembler can perform per cycle.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.speed_: Adjusts assembler speed after acceleration cards are counted. Negative values slow crafting.
Sets the base speed bonus to which other speed bonuses are added. If several nodes set it, the highest node ID wins.
Changes the number of virtual acceleration cards. Virtual and installed cards count together, up to five.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.throug: Changes how many recipe runs each Pattern Provider can dispatch per tick across all crafting CPUs.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.idle_f: Adds a fixed AE/t adjustment to idle power consumption. A positive value increases draw.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.idle_p: Changes idle power consumption by a percentage of the base draw. A positive value increases draw.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.craft_: Adds a fixed AE/t adjustment to assembler power consumption while crafting.
Changes assembler power consumption while crafting by a percentage of its base draw.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.channe: Adds or removes channels required by each matching device. A final cost of zero allows the device to run on power alone.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.effect.device: Adds slots to or removes slots from the finite limit after device caps apply. Without a finite limit or cap, the network stays unlimited.
Sets a base limit even in an unlimited network. The lowest finite limit is used before adding or removing slots from tree effects.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.enabled: Enables the research task board for players across the server.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.task_en: Allows this task to appear in its tier's offers while research tasks are enabled.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.repeata: Allows this task to be offered again after a reroll. When off, a network can claim its reward once.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.name: Title displayed on the player's task list. Use plain text or a translation key prefixed with @.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.descrip: Optional text that explains the objective to players. Supports plain text and @translation keys.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.id: Unique, stable task ID in namespace:path format. Changing it gives the task a new progress record.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.type: Determines whether progress counts completed CPU jobs, their output items, or items submitted from ME storage.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.item: An item to craft or submit, in namespace:item format. Leave blank to count all completed jobs for a jobs objective.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.tier: Selects the tier whose task pool includes this task. Tier 0 is used when no numbered tier matches.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.amount: Number of completed crafting jobs, crafted items, or submitted items required by the selected objective.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.points: Research points granted when the reward is claimed. Enter 0 for a task that rewards only items.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.rewards: Adds an item reward delivered to ME storage when the task is claimed.
Registry ID of the reward item. Click its slot to choose an item.
Number of copies of this item deposited into the ME network.
Removes this item from the reward list.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.tiers.i: Unique positive number for the new tier. Tier 0 is reserved for fallback tasks.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.tiers.m: Minimum total network points for this tier, including spent points. This boundary is inclusive.
The tier stops applying when total points reach this number. Leave blank to remove the upper bound.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.tiers.v: How many task offers the board can display at once for this tier.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.help.tasks.tiers.r: How many rewards must be claimed before completed offers are replaced.
Deletes this tier and moves its tasks to tier 0.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.mixed_lists: Editing replaces the list on all selected nodes.
aeupgrade.tree.editor.appearance_error: Use size 8–128, border widths 0–64, #RRGGBB color, and valid item or PNG IDs.

aeupgrade.tree.editor.tasks.tiers.range_: The lower bound is inclusive. Leave the upper bound blank for no limit. Tier 0 covers gaps.

aeupgrade.tree.editor.path_invalid: Enter a name. Use letters a–z, digits, dots, underscores or dashes in the group.
